public_url.description: The https address of this instance used in the links of mails; empty when not set

default_language.description: The language of mails to people without a language of their own. Default: en

alerts_admins.description: Mail alerts go to every enabled administrator with a valid address. Default: true

alerts_addresses.description: Extra addresses that get alert mails (at most 20, one plain address each). Set by ALERT_ADDRESSES (a comma list) when that variable is set

alerts_events.description: The events mailed as alerts: the state events and webhook.disabled (see GET /notifications/events). Default: every state event

reminder_hours.description: Hours between reminders of a state that is still bad, 0 for none. Default: 24

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the name of the environment variable that sets it

config_errors.description: Fields whose effective value is not valid (a restored row or an env value)
